notes.title: small bunch of fixes
notes.content:
Fixes to bugs in menus 
Fixes for mini games 
Better boot experience on first load 
Text appears as it should, notifying you when you unlock a mini game. 
Chinese fonts applied correctly to more text. 
Some tweaks to mini game UIs

notes.title: update
notes.content:
Bunch of bug fixes.

French fixed so no longer crashes the game, 
Some translation fixes
Some optimisations

notes.title: Multi threaded loading of assets
notes.content: Took a break from working on Grandma's in Hell to push an update to Starsaway. Now loads some things on another thread. Makes the game load content mid level much more smoothly especially on first play and on older hardware.

notes.title: Small tweak to fonts
notes.content: Some fonts were a little hard to read after the last update so this fixes that

notes.title: Updated to Godot 4.3 bringing performance improvements and some ui tweaks
notes.content:
First update to this game for a few months.

Updated to Godot 4.3 resulting in noticable performance improvements.

I also made a number of cosmetic changes to the ui.

notes.title: Small mouse fix
notes.content: A reviewer pointed out an issue where clicking with a mouse sometimes brings up a black circle. I believe this patch should fix that issue.

notes.title: 1.0.8 - Baked a cake
notes.content:
An endgame focus update that rebalances loop 4 and onwards as well as adding best times for completing loop 3 and loop 5 to the scoreboard.

Other changes include: 
Turned on msaa x2 for the lowest graphical setting.
Lightsabers don't have shadows and other minor graphical tweaks.

...Baked a cake.
